assertions: No dynamic Tailwind class construction: no template literals or string concatenation assemble class names
Complete class names for all four statuses appear statically in the source
No hardcoded hex colors in the component (Tailwind palette classes or project tokens only)

prompt: Build a small React component in a file called StatusBadge.tsx, styled with Tailwind, for a large existing Tailwind v4 app. Props: a status field of type 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'info'. Each status gets its own badge color (green, amber, red, blue). The badge shows the status text in a rounded pill. Write the file into the outputs directory.
